kabossImage.title: KABOSS IMAGE
kabossImage.short: Site y'ikigo cy'ibikorwa byinshi kuri KABOSS Inc i Nyamasheke, mu Rwanda — uri kuri murongo ikora.
kabossImage.overview: KABOSS IMAGE ni site ya KABOSS Inc, ikigo cy'ibikorwa byinshi i Nyamasheke, mu Rwanda. Site yerekana ibikorwa by'ikigo — printing, graphic design, photography, sound system n'ibikorwa bya digitali, harimo n'ukoresha Irembo — n'ibirori, amateka y'abakiriya n'amakuru yose y'ubuvandimwe.
kabossImage.problem: Ikigo kito cy'ibikorwa byinshi cyahungabana kugira ngo cyemeze kuri murongo: abakiriya bashobora kubona ibikorwa byose, kubona ibyo gikora, no kubona amakuru y'ubuvandimwe vuba — kuko abakiriya benshi babona ikigo kuri murongo mbere.
kabossImage.role: Nkora site kuri umukiriya, nkora igice ryanjye nkora n'ibindi bikorwa. Site iri kuri murongo ivuga "Developed by HIRWA Aime Jospin" mu musaruro.
built: Igice hejuru cya KABOSS Inc, gikora ikigo cy'ibikorwa byinshi, hamwe n'amashakira ajya kuri ibikorwa n'ubuvandimwe
Ibice bitandatu by'ibikorwa — Printing, Graphic Design, Photography, Sound System, Digital Services n'Irembo Assistance — byose bikwekweza ibikorwa byabo
Igice 'Why Choose KABOSS' cyerekeza ubuziranenge, gukoresha igihe, ibiciro byiza n'umwete w'abakiriya
Igice cy'amateka y'abakiriya hamwe n'amagambo atatu
Igice cyo guhamagara n'umusaruro ukwekweza amashakira, urutonde rw'ibikorwa, amakuru y'ubuvandimwe, amasaha n'ibikoresho bya WhatsApp
kabossImage.learned: Kubungabunga site y'umukiriya kuri murongo, ikora vuba kandi ikora neza — no kuvugana ibikorwa byose mbere y'ibibazo by'abakiriya.
kabossImage.screenshotsNote: Ibishushanyo bya site bizashyizwe na we (reba docs/CONTENT-TODO.md).

umudugudu.title: Umudugudu Management System
umudugudu.short: Icyitegererezo gikora cyo kuyobora amakuru y'abaturage mu mudugudu (umudugudu).
umudugudu.overview: Umudugudu Management System ni icyitegererezo gikora cyo kuyobora amakuru y'abaturage mu mudugudu — igice cy'ibanze cy'ubutegetsi mu Rwanda, nk'umudugudu (icyaro).
umudugudu.problem: Abayobozi bo mu gice bakora amakuru y'abaturage ku papyire cyangwa mu dushya. Sisitemu ndende ya digitale ishobora gufasha kubungabunga amakuru neza no kuyisura vuba.
umudugudu.role: Nkubaka icyitegererezo uri i PHP n'HTML.
built: Icyitegererezo gikora cyo kuyobora amakuru y'abaturage, kikozwe mu PHP n'HTML
We nyuma uyavuga ko ifite ibikorwa byinshi — urutonde rw'ibikorwa ruzashyizwe (reba docs/CONTENT-TODO.md)
umudugudu.learned: Guhindura uburyo bwo kwandika amakuru mu bikorwa by'ubutegetsi — n'umwete w'ibikorwa by'abaturage.
umudugudu.demoDataNote: Ikibazo cy'umwete: ibishushanyo bizashyizwe bizerekana date ya kabuhariwe gusa. Amakuru y'abaturage ntarekwa kuri uru portfolio.
